text:
Ava (Content): draft ready — two hero variants + short benchmark callout. asking for quick heatcheck and legal signoff on the latency claim.

Ava (Content): VAR A (headline): 'Ship LLM features 3x faster with predictable inference'
VAR B (headline): 'Cut inference cost and latency — build with predictable SLAs'
Benchmark blurb: 'In internal tests, Redwood Reduced median generation latency by 3x vs baseline on 2k token workloads.'
CTA options: `Request demo`, `Join waitlist`, `See benchmarks`

Jules (Growth): love the two angles. quick q — which CTA maps to our lead routing? we should A/B the hero CTA on the landing.

Priya (Demand): routing: `Request demo` -> Sales SDR queue, `Join waitlist` -> nurture flow, `See benchmarks` -> send to benchmark drip. can confirm HubSpot lists. also prefer `Request demo` for paid demos.

Noah (Design): hero comps are ready for both variants. VAR A image: dev at laptop + latency viz. VAR B image: cost/stack diagram. can swap hero if copy leans into cost.

Liam (Ops): webinar/demo seat capacity note — if CTA is `Request demo` we should gate by region and burst capacity. recommend limiting immediate booking to EMEA + NA and direct APAC to waitlist.

Sam (Product): legal check on the "3x" claim. has that been validated across models and quant levels? if not, we need qualifier: 'up to 3x' or 'in our internal benchmarks'. can @legal take a look? :eyes:

Ava (Content): good call. how about small qualifier: 'In internal benchmarks, Redwood reduced median generation latency by up to 3x on long-context workloads.' shorter for hero: 'Up to 3x lower latency on long-context requests.'

Jules (Growth): i like the qualifier. for A/B we should test hero copy + CTA pairs: (VAR A + Request demo) vs (VAR B + See benchmarks). small sample for launch page — 7d test.

Priya (Demand): HubSpot tagging snippet for the landing form (use exact names so ops can route):
```
hs_form_name: "launch_demo_request_v1"
hubspot_owner: "SDR-Pipeline"
utm_source: "organic"
utm_campaign: "launch_q2_inference"
cta_label: "Request demo"
```

Liam (Ops): noted. i'll add routing rules: request_demo -> slack #sales-live + create lead in HS with tag `launch_q2_inference`. also will throttle form submissions to 1/min per IP.

Sam (Product): +1 on qualifier. also add fallback line for canary: 'If capacity constrained, we may offer waitlist booking.' ensures we don't overpromise.

Ava (Content): updated copy below — please quickapprove so I can send to creative and legal: 
VAR A hero: 'Up to 3x lower latency on long-context requests'
Subhead: 'Ship LLM features with predictable performance and lower per-token cost.'
CTA: 'Request demo' (primary) / 'See benchmarks' (secondary)

Noah (Design): final comps attached in Figma link: https://figma.com/file/xyz — I'll swap hero image if we lock copy.

Sam (Product): @legal, can you review the qualifier language? need approval by EOD today if possible. thanks.

publish-bot: Created task #1024 in Marketing Launch board: 'Finalize hero copy + legal signoff' assigned to Ava (Content).

Jules (Growth): once legal thumbs up, i'll set up the A/B in VWO and wire the CTA to the routing that Priya outlined. will ping when ready. :rocket:

Ava (Content): thanks everyone — i'll queue legal and update the doc. leaving this thread open for any last-minute picks on CTAs or hero angle. :thumbsup:
